source: Original fictional game content; real-world framing from public reporting as of November 2026 (see docs/DATA_SOURCES.md)

events.title: Election-year pressure
events.text: With a national vote approaching, polling shows {PLAYER}'s government trailing on living costs and security. Advisers offer a spending package, a fiscal-discipline message, or a tougher line toward {TARGET} to rally support.

choices.label: Announce a spending package
choices.tooltip: Buys popularity now at a budget cost.

choices.label: Campaign on fiscal discipline
choices.tooltip: Unpopular in the short run; helps growth later.

choices.label: Talk tough on {TARGET}
choices.tooltip: Rallies voters but damages relations and raises tension.

events.title: Budget shortfall
events.text: Revenue has come in well below forecast and the finance ministry warns {PLAYER} that the deficit is unsustainable without action this quarter.

choices.label: Cut defence procurement
choices.tooltip: Frees cash now; the armed forces lose planned modernisation.

choices.label: Raise taxes
choices.tooltip: Closes the gap but slows the economy and angers voters.

choices.label: Borrow and defer
choices.tooltip: Painless now; debt service drags on growth for two years.

events.title: Cyberattack on infrastructure
events.text: A coordinated intrusion disrupts power distribution and payment systems in several of {PLAYER}'s cities for most of a day. Forensic teams attribute the operation with moderate confidence to actors linked to {TARGET}.

choices.label: Retaliate in kind
choices.tooltip: Covert response that raises tension but sharpens your cyber forces.

choices.label: Attribute publicly and sanction
choices.tooltip: Imposes sanctions on {TARGET}; relations fall sharply.

choices.label: Harden systems quietly
choices.tooltip: Spends on resilience and avoids a diplomatic fight.

events.title: Mass protests spread
events.text: Demonstrations over prices and governance spread from the capital to provincial cities. Security services ask {PLAYER} for guidance before the weekend marches.

choices.label: Concede reforms
choices.tooltip: Calms the streets at a fiscal cost.

choices.label: Order a crackdown
choices.tooltip: Restores order for now; damages the economy and your image abroad.

choices.label: Wait it out
choices.tooltip: No cost today; the movement may grow.

events.title: Joint exercise invitation
events.text: {TARGET} invites {PLAYER} to join a large multinational exercise next quarter. Participation would signal solidarity, but rivals will read it as a message aimed at them.

choices.label: Join with a full contingent
choices.tooltip: Strengthens the partnership; small cost and a nudge to global tension.

choices.label: Send observers only
choices.tooltip: Minimal commitment, minimal benefit.

choices.label: Decline
choices.tooltip: Avoids provoking rivals; the partner is disappointed.

events.title: Arms-sale request
events.text: {TARGET} requests a major package of air-defence and precision-strike systems from {PLAYER}. The deal would support domestic industry but would be noticed by {TARGET}'s neighbours.

choices.label: Approve the full sale
choices.tooltip: Revenue and a stronger partner; slightly higher regional tension.

choices.label: Approve with end-use conditions
choices.tooltip: Smaller deal, fewer complications.

choices.label: Decline
choices.tooltip: Avoids entanglement; the partner looks elsewhere.

events.title: Intelligence leak
events.text: Classified assessments of {PLAYER}'s war plans and partner capabilities appear online. {TARGET} demands an explanation about material that references its forces.

choices.label: Prosecute and brief partners fully
choices.tooltip: Restores trust abroad at some domestic embarrassment.

choices.label: Overhaul security clearances
choices.tooltip: Costly reforms that improve future resilience.

choices.label: Downplay the leak
choices.tooltip: Cheapest option; partners lose confidence.

events.title: Refugee influx at the border
events.text: Conflict and economic collapse drive large numbers of people toward {PLAYER}'s border with {TARGET}. Border agencies report facilities at capacity.

choices.label: Open the border and register arrivals
choices.tooltip: Humanitarian credit and future labour; short-term strain at home.

choices.label: Close the border
choices.tooltip: Popular at home; sours relations with the neighbour.

choices.label: Fund reception centres abroad
choices.tooltip: Spends money to keep the problem at arm's length.

events.title: General strike called
events.text: Unions call an indefinite general strike over wages and pensions. Ports and transport are at a standstill and employers urge {PLAYER} to intervene.

choices.label: Negotiate a settlement
choices.tooltip: Ends the strike quickly at a fiscal cost.

choices.label: Hold firm
choices.tooltip: No concessions; the economy takes a lasting hit.

choices.label: Invoke emergency powers
choices.tooltip: Restores services but draws criticism from democratic partners.

events.title: Market crash
events.text: Equity markets fall sharply for a third day amid a credit scare, and {PLAYER}'s central bank asks for a decision on emergency support before markets reopen.

choices.label: Announce a large bailout
choices.tooltip: Expensive but limits the damage to output.

choices.label: Let markets clear
choices.tooltip: No bailout; a deeper, lasting hit to GDP and confidence.

choices.label: Coordinate with partner central banks
choices.tooltip: Shares the burden and builds goodwill.

events.title: Oil price shock
events.text: Disruption in Gulf shipping sends crude prices sharply higher. Fuel protests are reported and {PLAYER}'s energy ministry proposes emergency measures.

choices.label: Release strategic reserves
choices.tooltip: Softens prices at a budget cost.

choices.label: Impose fuel rationing
choices.tooltip: Saves money; unpopular and slows the economy.

choices.label: Negotiate supply deal with Gulf producers
choices.tooltip: Secures supply and improves ties with Riyadh and Abu Dhabi.

events.title: Drone incursion
events.text: Unidentified drones overfly a military base and a power station in {PLAYER}'s territory. Radar tracks point toward {TARGET}, which denies any involvement.

choices.label: Shoot down and protest publicly
choices.tooltip: Firm response; relations and tension worsen.

choices.label: Lodge a quiet protest
choices.tooltip: Keeps the incident contained.

choices.label: Launch reciprocal reconnaissance
choices.tooltip: Gathers intelligence at the price of escalation.

events.title: Submarine incident
events.text: A submarine believed to belong to {TARGET} is detected inside {PLAYER}'s territorial waters near a naval base before withdrawing. The navy asks whether to publicise the intrusion.

choices.label: Publicise the intrusion
choices.tooltip: Rallies opinion; relations and tension suffer.

choices.label: Raise it on the military hotline
choices.tooltip: Keeps channels open and tension down.

choices.label: Step up anti-submarine patrols
choices.tooltip: Spends on readiness and signals vigilance.

events.title: Rival tests hypersonic weapon
events.text: {TARGET} announces a successful test of a hypersonic glide vehicle able to defeat current missile defences. {PLAYER}'s defence chiefs request an urgent response.

choices.label: Launch a crash programme
choices.tooltip: Large research boost; expensive.

choices.label: Propose arms-control talks
choices.tooltip: Lowers tension and improves relations.

choices.label: Dismiss the test publicly
choices.tooltip: No cost; a small knock to confidence.

events.title: Novel pathogen scare
events.text: A cluster of severe respiratory cases with an unidentified pathogen is reported in a major transport hub. Health officials ask {PLAYER} for an immediate policy on borders and gatherings.

choices.label: Close borders and restrict travel
choices.tooltip: Reassures the public but hits the economy and the neighbour.

choices.label: Coordinate an international response
choices.tooltip: Moderate cost; builds goodwill.

choices.label: Take minimal measures
choices.tooltip: Cheap now; a lasting hit if the outbreak spreads.

events.title: Domestic AI breakthrough
events.text: A national laboratory in {PLAYER} demonstrates an AI system with major military and industrial applications. Ministers disagree on whether to classify it, commercialise it, or restrict exports.

choices.label: Classify for defence use
choices.tooltip: Big research gain; rivals react and civilian growth suffers.

choices.label: Commercialise openly
choices.tooltip: Strong growth boost and modest research gain.

choices.label: Restrict exports to rivals
choices.tooltip: Balanced approach; partners appreciate the coordination.

events.title: Semiconductor export controls
events.text: Trade officials propose tightening controls on advanced chips and chip-making tools bound for {TARGET}. Industry warns of lost sales; security agencies warn of lost advantage.

choices.label: Tighten the controls
choices.tooltip: Slows the rival's progress; costs sales and relations.

choices.label: Hold current rules
choices.tooltip: No change.

choices.label: Loosen controls for a trade deal
choices.tooltip: Revenue and a thaw; the rival gains technology.

events.title: Security Council vote
events.text: A resolution condemning {TARGET}'s recent actions comes to a vote at the United Nations. {PLAYER}'s delegation needs instructions.

choices.label: Vote in favour
choices.tooltip: Aligns with partners; relations with the target fall.

choices.label: Abstain
choices.tooltip: Pleases no one; small costs on both sides.

choices.label: Vote against
choices.tooltip: Wins favour with the target; Western partners object.

events.title: War-weariness protests
events.text: After months of fighting, anti-war demonstrations draw large crowds in {PLAYER}'s cities and casualty figures dominate the news. Veterans' groups call for talks with {TARGET}.

choices.label: Open ceasefire talks
choices.tooltip: Calms the home front and lowers tension; the enemy senses weakness.

choices.label: Rally the nation
choices.tooltip: Keeps the war effort going at an economic cost.

choices.label: Suppress the protests
choices.tooltip: Short-term order; long-term instability and allied criticism.

events.title: Unrest in the ranks
events.text: Reports reach {PLAYER} of units refusing orders over unpaid wages and poor conditions. Commanders warn that discipline could break down if nothing is done.

choices.label: Pay arrears and improve conditions
choices.tooltip: Expensive but restores loyalty.

choices.label: Purge the officer corps
choices.tooltip: Removes plotters but weakens the force.

choices.label: Ignore the reports
choices.tooltip: Nothing spent; the rot spreads.

events.title: Coup attempt
events.text: Armoured units seize broadcasting centres and the airport in {PLAYER}'s capital. Loyalist forces are moving, but the outcome depends on decisions taken in the next hours.

choices.label: Crush the coup with loyalist forces
choices.tooltip: The government survives; the economy and public trust take a heavy hit.

effects.text: Coup attempt put down after street fighting in the capital

choices.label: Negotiate a power-sharing deal
choices.tooltip: Avoids bloodshed; the new arrangement is fragile.

effects.text: Government and rebel officers agree transitional power-sharing arrangement

choices.label: Step aside; regime collapses
choices.tooltip: A transitional government takes over: demobilisation, de-escalation and a sharp economic contraction.

effects.text: Government falls; transitional council announces demobilisation and review of foreign commitments

events.title: Major earthquake
events.text: A powerful earthquake strikes a populated region of {TARGET}, damaging infrastructure and displacing thousands. International rescue teams are dispatched.

choices.label: Disaster response under way
choices.tooltip: The affected nation's economy and stability take a hit.

effects.text: Major earthquake causes widespread damage; international aid mobilised

events.title: Coup in {TARGET}
events.text: Military officers announce they have taken power in {TARGET}, suspending the constitution and closing borders. Regional bodies condemn the takeover.

choices.label: Junta consolidates
choices.tooltip: Stability and output fall; Western ties sour.

effects.text: Military seizes power in surprise coup; borders closed and constitution suspended

events.title: Fusion energy milestone
events.text: A consortium reports sustained net-energy fusion in a pilot plant, a result quickly replicated by rival programmes. Energy ministries revise long-term forecasts.

choices.label: Research race accelerates
choices.tooltip: Major research boost for leading technology powers.

effects.text: Pilot plant reports sustained net-energy fusion; governments boost research budgets

events.title: OPEC+ announces output cut
events.text: OPEC+ members agree a significant production cut to support prices. Importing economies brace for higher fuel costs while producers see revenue gains.

choices.label: Prices rise
choices.tooltip: Producers gain, importers slow.

effects.text: OPEC+ agrees output cut; crude prices climb

events.title: OPEC+ raises output
events.text: OPEC+ agrees to unwind earlier cuts and raise production, citing market share concerns. Crude prices fall and import-dependent economies get relief.

choices.label: Prices fall
choices.tooltip: Importers gain, producers lose revenue.

effects.text: OPEC+ raises output; crude prices slide

events.title: Red Sea cables cut
events.text: Several submarine data cables in the Red Sea are severed within hours, slowing internet traffic between Europe and Asia. Investigators examine ship-tracking data for a dragged anchor or deliberate act.

choices.label: Repairs will take weeks
choices.tooltip: Economic disruption in the region and a notch of global tension.

effects.text: Multiple Red Sea data cables severed; Europe-Asia traffic rerouted

events.title: Famine declared in the Horn of Africa
events.text: UN agencies declare famine conditions in parts of Sudan and Ethiopia after failed rains and continued fighting block aid deliveries.

choices.label: Aid appeal launched
choices.tooltip: Affected states lose stability.

effects.text: UN declares famine in parts of Sudan and Ethiopia; aid access blocked by fighting

events.title: Sovereign debt default
events.text: {TARGET} misses a bond payment and asks creditors for a restructuring. Currency and bank shares fall sharply; the IMF opens emergency talks.

choices.label: Restructuring talks begin
choices.tooltip: A sharp hit to the defaulting economy.

effects.text: Sovereign default triggers emergency IMF talks and market sell-off

events.title: Mediterranean migrant surge
events.text: Arrivals across the central Mediterranean reach their highest level in years as conflicts and economic collapse push people from North Africa and the Sahel. Southern European governments demand EU burden-sharing.

choices.label: Reception systems strained
choices.tooltip: Political strain in southern Europe.

effects.text: Record Mediterranean crossings strain southern European reception systems

events.title: Orbital collision
events.text: A defunct satellite collides with a spent rocket stage in low Earth orbit, creating a debris cloud that forces several operators to manoeuvre. Governments trade accusations over who failed to deorbit.

choices.label: Debris tracked
choices.tooltip: Space powers bicker; tracking research gets a boost.

effects.text: Orbital collision creates debris cloud; satellite operators forced to manoeuvre

events.title: Global cyber worm
events.text: A self-propagating worm exploiting an unpatched industrial-control flaw disrupts logistics and manufacturing systems across several continents before a fix is distributed.

choices.label: Patch distributed
choices.tooltip: Small GDP losses in major economies and a rise in tension.

effects.text: Worldwide worm outbreak halts factories and ports; emergency patch released

events.title: Election surprise in {TARGET}
events.text: Voters in {TARGET} deliver an unexpected result, bringing to power a government that promises to review foreign commitments and alliances.

choices.label: New government sworn in
choices.tooltip: A period of uncertainty and a review of ties with your nation.

effects.text: Surprise election result brings government pledging foreign-policy review

events.title: BRICS summit agrees payments pact
events.text: BRICS leaders agree to expand settlement in national currencies and a joint development-bank facility. Washington calls the move an effort to evade sanctions.

choices.label: Pact signed
choices.tooltip: BRICS members draw closer; US ties with Brazil cool.

effects.text: BRICS summit agrees expanded local-currency settlement pact

events.title: NATO burden-sharing row
events.text: A NATO leaders' meeting ends in public disagreement over defence-spending targets, with Washington threatening to review deployments in countries it says are lagging.

choices.label: Summit ends in discord
choices.tooltip: US ties with laggards suffer; front-line states gain favour.

effects.text: NATO summit ends in open dispute over defence spending

events.title: Pakistan-Afghanistan border clashes
events.text: Heavy fighting erupts along the Pakistan-Afghanistan frontier after cross-border attacks, with airstrikes reported and crossings closed. Mediators in Doha and Beijing call for a ceasefire.

choices.label: Fighting continues for days
choices.tooltip: Relations worsen and Pakistan's stability dips.

effects.text: Pakistan and Afghanistan exchange airstrikes and artillery along border

events.title: Gaza phase-two talks
events.text: Mediators from Egypt, Qatar and the United States convene talks on the next phase of the Gaza ceasefire, covering security arrangements and reconstruction. Progress is slow but the truce is reaffirmed.

choices.label: Truce reaffirmed
choices.tooltip: Small improvements in Israel's ties with mediators.

effects.text: Gaza ceasefire reaffirmed as phase-two talks continue in Cairo
